title.zh: 将罗哈斯市洛克图甘小学更名为何塞·洪蒂维罗斯小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Loctugan Elementary School in the City of Roxas to Jose Hontiveros Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Loctugan Elementary School in the City of Roxas to Jose Hontiveros Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Loctugan tại Thành phố Roxas thành Trường tiểu học Jose Hontiveros
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Loctugan ในเมือง Roxas เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Jose Hontiveros
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Loctugan di Kota Roxas menjadi Sekolah Dasar Jose Hontiveros
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Loctugan di Bandaraya Roxas menjadi Sekolah Rendah Jose Hontiveros

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5602_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Loctugan Elementary School in the City of Roxas is hereby changed to Jose Hontiveros Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
